tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// kulishawarmāshast+raunāmashrībadzramahākālapañdzaraṣyanāthasyottaratsakrarakṣashtsāntatrināḍapañtsatsakreṣushrītobasebabidhikarmikābishiṣṭakaḥsādahanobidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo dang nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor khyad par ba'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i go mtshon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mthu stobs che mchog rdo rje mkhar gdengs pas// bar chad bgegs dgra'i ri bo'i rgyun lugs bcad// rgyal bstan legs bris rgyal thabs skyong byed pa// bla ma gur mgon lha brgya'i mgon pos srungs// snyan brgyud gdams ngag tshad mas bstan srung che// rang dbang nye bar khugs pa de nas brtsams// byang chub bar du mi 'bral mnyam 'grogs nas// ci 'dod las bzhi sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub mthu// yid 'phrog sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i glu len mas// rgyal kun gsang gsum bskul ba'i mthu rdzogs na// snang grags stong nyid zung 'jug sgrub pa'i thabs// zab mo yi ge spel ba'i rjes su 'gro// de'ang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bstan srung kun gyi dbang po rdo rje gur gyi mgon po la/ sgrub tshul gyi rnam gzhag gdams pa mang du bzhugs pa'i nang gsal/ mgon po bdag bskyed la brten nas yi dam ltar sgrub pa 'di nyid gegs chung zhing dngos grub myur ba 'di nyid do// de la 'di'i rjes gnang gdams pa dang bcas pa legs par thob pas/ rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la spyi'i sngon 'gro dang*/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po la bzhi las skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes bzhi skor ram/

spro na de'i steng du yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bsnan pa'i drug skor gang rung gis skyabs 'gro ci nus byas mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim par bsam/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du nag po chen po'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni kye rdo rje ltar bya'o// bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i nang du/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po 'khor bcas/ de'i dbu'i steng du rang rang gi byin rlabs khrid bcas gang las brgyud pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ dper na/ bdag gis phyi khrid rgyas pa dang nang khrid drag po sngags rgod/ gsang khrid sems nyid ye shes rtsal 'don dang bcas rgyas par thob pa'i brgyud pa ltar na/ de'i dbu'i steng du bka' drin zla med mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de'i dbu steng nas yar rim bzhin/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yan chad nang gsang kun la 'dra'o// yang na phyi khrid kyi rkang grangs rags pa tsam dang*/ gsang khrid lha dgu'i rjes gnang dang 'brel bar rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i gsang khrid zab mo smin rgyas dang*/

drag po sngags rgod/ sems nyid ye shes rtsal 'don rnams nyams khrid du thob pa dang gong gi phyi khrid bcas pa'i brgyud pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdams te brjod na/ de'i dbu'i steng du bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa/ de'i dbu'i steng ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang gsum tha mi dad pa/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs gsum tha mi dad pa/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan gsum tha mi dad pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gnyis tha mi dad pa/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis tha mi dad pa/ de nas phyi nang gsang khrid gsum ga ltar yang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ mkhan btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mthu chen ā nan dam pa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ mal blo gros grags pa/ sngags 'chang yon tan tshul khrims/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ shraddha ka ra warma/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad sku gur gyi mgon po'i rnam pa can bdag la dgyes shing 'dzum pa/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can du tho brtsegs su bzhugs par gyur ces brjod/ de la goms pas de tsam mi nus na/ de'i steng du bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nas sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad sku gur gyi mgon po'i rnam pa sogs sngar bzhin brjod kyang rung ngo*// de nas de dag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas spyi bo'i bla ma rnams la cha tshang ba re thim pas/ thams cad kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen gyis byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'od du zhu nas slob dpon bram ze mchog sred la thim/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon bram ze mchog sred la gsol ba 'debs so// slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis byin gyis rlobs shig slob dpon bram ze mchog sred 'od du zhu nas zhes sogs tshig bzhi po 'og ma thams cad la sbyar te/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje la/ shraddhā ka ra warma la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po la/ sngags 'chang yon tan tshul khrims sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar te/ 'jam dbyangs mkhan brtse'i dbang phyug la/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel la/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan la/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs la/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang la zhes sam/ phyi nang gsang khrid bcas pa'i brgyud pa ltar na/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bar 'dra ba la/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis tha mi dad pa nas/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la thim/ mkhas btsun kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang gsum tha mi dad pa la/ bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus nas las bzhi'i phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'og gi mgon po 'khor bcas 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ zhes dang*/ spro na gang drin ma sogs kyi bstod pa dang gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ de nas rgyun gyi nyams len lta bu la/ maṇḍal mi 'bul na/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs kyi gsol ba btab nas bstims pa yin yang*/ maṇḍal gyi rnal 'byor byed pa na/ maṇḍal la/ dri bzang btab pa'i chus khyab par byug cing 'bru gtsang ma'i tshom bu dgod pa dang bstun te/ maṇḍal so bdun pas thog drangs tshom bu bdun pa gtso bor 'bul/ skabs 'gar so bdun ma gsol gdab bcas bya/ de'ang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol zhes bya ba la sogs pas bla ma mchod pa spyi ltar gsol ba 'debs shing maṇḍal ci nus bsags mthar/ gong gi mchod rdzas dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de rjes/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid 'od sngon por zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsams la 'dzin med du mnyam par 'jog go /gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nag po chen po lha bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/

na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma shrī ma hā kā la maṇḍa le bhyaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ shrī gu ru ma hā kā la maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ne wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur par bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ nang rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'o// dang po la/ bsrung ba/ bzlog pa/ bsad pa ste gsum las/ dang po la zab pa'i gnad lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len pa dang*/ khyad par gyi man ngag mde'u kha gdags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong dmar nag gru gsum pa mtho zhing ngom chod pa/ de'i steng du e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba nang khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtshos gang ba/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bsams la/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/

oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag re re/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid nag po chen po lha bcu gcig gi sku cig car du gyur pa ni/ dbus su bdag nyid rdo rje nag po chen po che zhing cher 'bar ba/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag 'bum sde gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag 'bum sde 'khang zhing zugs pa/ rgyab na lcags spyang 'bum sde g.yal zhing rgyug pa/ mdun na mi nag 'bum sde gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na nam mkha'i lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa 'phro ba ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// phyogs bcu'i mgon po rnams sku mdog mthing nag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'khor lo'i rgyab rwa gur gyi nang dur khrod brgyad na phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ klu dang*/ sprin dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs la sogs pa du ma dang*/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs dregs byed dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nag po chen po lha bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las lha bcu gcig la mi bskyod pa re res dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar shar sgom gyi tshul du nyams su blang*/ de nas rang nyid 'bras bu'i dus kyi bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa'i rdo rje gur gyi mgon po de nga nyid yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bya/ de'ang ji lta bu zhig yin na nag po chen po'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ shin tu 'jigs shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can la sems ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog pa ni bskyed rim gyi dngos gzhi yin no// de ltar bsgoms pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa langs thabs su yod pa'i lte bar sems rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po gsal zhing 'tsher ba/

de'i klad kor gyi nang du bla ma/ rang nyid nang du/ mdun du pha ma dang dpon po/ g.yas su pho nye/ g.yon du mo nye/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu nor phyugs khang zhing*/ de dag gi ming yig dang bcas pa bsrung bya rnams kyang rang rang gi cha lugs gsal zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ rnam par shes pa rnams kyang bkug ste rang rang la thim par bsams pa ni/ sgo gsum sba ba'o// de rnams kyi mthar sngags thung gnyis dang*/ shā sa na'i sngags phreng kha dog mthing gas g.yas skor du bskor ba/ hūm̐ de las rdo rje phra mo nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab kyis gtams par bsams pa ni go bgo ba'o// de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bo maṃ yig ser po dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'khor lo la thim pas 'khor lo'i nus pa rab tu rgyas par bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'ur gyis 'khor/ lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing 'khor lo 'khor ba'i phyi nang thams cad me dpung drag tu 'bar bas gdon bgegs rnams bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar gzhob thul gyis tshig par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa ces yi ge bdun pa ci nus bzla'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i man ngag ni/ rang nyid mgon por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gsal btab/ dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang yon tan thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bkug dpral bar thim pas lus thams cad gang bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag lha 'dres mnan pa la sogs pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsal/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par bsams la 'dzin med kyi ngang du 'jog

de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od 'phros/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang yon tan thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bkug mgrin par thim/ lus gang ngag gi sdig sgrib dag mnan pa sogs kyi nyes skyon thams cad bsal/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung dang nus pa mnyam pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang yon tan thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bkug snying gar thim/ lus gang*/ sems kyi sdig sgrib dag rmongs rmugs 'khrug pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsal/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dang nus pa mnyam zhes pa rnams bsgyur te bsgom mo// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma ma kā ya wāktsitta rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi man ngag mde'u kha gdags pa la/ btsan po'i mkhar du bcug pa/ khams gsum g.yul du bcad pa/ rno gsum mtshon du brdung pa/ 'khor lo jag pa bkye ba rnams ni don du gnyer bas khrid gzhung dang zhal las shes par byas te bsgom mo// sngags kyi bzlas pa'i mjug tu oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang*/ shā sa na nyer gcig tsam bzlas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje nag po chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa bzlog pa la/ spyi'i bzlog pa ni/ bdag la gzhan gyi rbod gtong la sogs pa'i ltas byung ba'am ma byung yang rung ste/ gzhan sngar bzhin las 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar brgyad kyi rdo rje'i sa gzhir yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba/ de'i steng du nṛ tṛ sṛ las dgra bo pho gdon mo gdon rnams lus rid pa/

skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyugs pa/ spyi bo tshugs su gnas pa gsum re bskyed la/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo dus mtha'i rlung gi shugs dang ldan pa/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de rnams kyis gnod byed gang du gnas pa nas rang dbang med par bkug ste rtsibs bar gyi dgra bgegs rnams la bstim par bsams la/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa dang*/ sdang zhing tho btsams pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs liṅga 'di la myur ba nyid du khug cig phob cig ces dang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa yang yang brjod cing bstim mo// de nas bdag nyid khros pa'i nyams kyis hūm̐ zhes 'jigs pa'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ zhabs brdabs pas/ phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams khro 'khrugs rngam pas zhal phyir gzigs/ steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ 'khor lo g.yon skor du shugs drag pos 'khor ba dang*/ dgra bgegs rnams me rlung gis rim bzhin btegs pas rkang pa nas spyi bo'i bar du dum bur gtubs/ ro ma lhung ba rnams mes bsregs/ rlung gis rjes med du gtor/ las ngan dag nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas par bsams la/ shā sa na spel tshig can nyung mtha' drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs bzlas te/ de'ang i daṃ duṣṭāṃ gnod byed kha kha/ gnod byed khā hi khā hi sogs man chad kun la sbyar ba'am mi nus na/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan gcig sbyar nas man chad dkyus ltar brjod pas kyang btub bo// de'i tshe pho nya dregs byed dang bcas pa grangs med pas phyi rol du 'thon nas rbod gtong gnod byed byad mar bcas pa bsgral zhing bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i las byed par bsam mo// de nas bha ya nā sa tshar gsum dang*/

su gang dag ces sogs brjod pas dmod pa 'dor te/ de'ang lag pa gnyis gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan par bsams/ g.yas pa'i mthil du dgra bgegs dmigs te bkug la/ g.yon pa'i thal mo lan gsum brdabs pas sha khrag dmar chal gyis song*/ ro ma rnams zhabs 'og gi khro bo'i zhal du bstabs pas bzhes par bsams la/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni zhes sogs brjod la 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog go /khyad par gyi bzlog pa ni/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe bya ba bgegs bzlog pa la sogs pa bdun dang*/ de dag thun mong du mkho ba'i man ngag sprul pa spro ba dang yang sprul spro ba rnams ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// slar hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing brtan par bsams la oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐ zhes srung sngags brjod do// gsum pa bsad pa ni/ shā sa na spel tshig can bzla zhing dmigs pa ni zhal las shes so// 'dir 'og gi gsang khrid sogs mi bsgom par spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa khro bo bcu la thim/ khro bo bcu gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang nag po chen po'i nga rgyal gyis ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyi rol du thun mong ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo sngar bzhin du grub par bsams la/ rang rtag tu de'i nang du spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor bya'o// phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo'i srung bzlog bsad gsum kho na nyams su len pas gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// de dag gis ni phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la spyir nang dang gsang ba'i brag rdzong mas byas pa'i khrid tshul dang*/

nang khrid thun mong bas byas pa'i khrid tshul dang*/ nang khrid thun mong ma yin pa gsang khrid kyis byas pa'i khrid tshul rnams las/ 'dir mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs lam gyi gtso bo/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag gi nyams khrid thob pas nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ phyi khrid rgyas pa dang ma 'brel bar zur du nyams su len yang btub mod/ de ltar na gong du bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/ dngos gzhi la thun mong srung 'khor bsgoms pa'i nang du rang gtso bo gcig pu bskyed de bsgom pa yin/ phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas pa dang 'brel pa na/ sngon 'gro rnams snga ma des thus par byas nas/ 'dir rten dang brten pa'i tshul gyis 'brel bar nyams su len pa la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ rang nyid dbus kyi gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma he ru ka mgon po lha dgu dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi lus rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa ni/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma sngo bsangs thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ g.yas su ro ma dmar gsal rakta'i dwangs mas gang ba/ g.yon rkyang ma dkar dwangs byang chub sems kyis gang ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rnams rtsa mdud gyes pas 'dab ma'i rnam pa can/ gsang gnas rtsa gsum gyi 'dus mdor chos 'byung gru gsum smug nag bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gdeng kha che ba lte 'og sor bzhir sleb pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/

de'i nang du chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul yum chen e ka dza ṭī chos dbyings nam mkha'i rang bzhin sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi me'i phyag rgyas g.yu'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa len bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de las 'od sngon po gsum chad pa rtsa gsum gyi nang nas gyen du song*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi dbu ma'i rtsa thig rlung gsum 'od dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rtsa 'khor gyi stod tsam du bla ma he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa gru mo g.yon gyi khug na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga brten pa/ spyi bor ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon bskums pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i 'og thad kyi ro ma dang dbyer med pa'i gur mgon dang*/ g.yon rkyang ma dang dbyer med pa'i lha mo gtor chog ltar gsal btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od sngon po gcig chad/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūm̐ yig tu gyur/ dbu ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ las kyi mgon po ber nag zangs gri can sku mdog mthing nag g.yas dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod pa'i zangs gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dam nyams kyi snying khrag gsol ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum bgrad pa/ ral pa kham nag nam mkhar gzings pa/ dar nag po'i 'jol ber gseng ma sum brtsegs gsol ba la gser gyi sga po che bcings pa/ sag ti'i lh+wam 'bog gsol ba'i zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon bgrad pa'o// gur mgon gyi thugs ka nas ya chad pa ro ma dang dbyer med pa'i nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi gri gug dang*/

g.yon spar ba phyir gdengs pa'i lag mthil na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ deng phon gser ma'i phod ka dang mi lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lding stabs su gyon zhing*/ gser gyi rna cha 'phyang ba/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas mma chad pa rkyang ma dang dbyer med pa'i nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas spu gri dang*/ g.yon spar ba phyir gdengs pa'i lag mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ dar nag po gser gyi thig le can gyi gos gyon zhing*/ byi ru'i lan tshar 'phyang ba/ gnod sbyin gyi thugs ka nas tri gnyis chad pa las ro ma dang dbyer med pa'i stod du pu tra nag po g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i aṃ ga rag dang*/ dar man gyi na bza' can/ smad du bha ṭa nag po g.yas dam shing dang*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ stag slog gyon zhing man tri'i ga sha can/ gnod byin mo'i thugs ka nas bhyoḥ gcig chad pa las rkyang ma dang dbyer med pa'i sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma nag mo g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu zhags zhal du 'drad cing kha nas me 'bar ba/ gcer bu ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma he ru ka mgon po lha dgu dang bcas pa gong ltar spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las bla ma he ru ka dang gur gyi mgon po la mi bskyod pa/ gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re res dbur brgyan/ bla ma'i phyag tu dam tshig gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs nas lha rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa na de 'dra re chad pa spyi bo nas thim pas snying gar gnas par bsams la/

rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// 'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas dam la bzhag gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes pas byin brlabs nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā la de wyai sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥsogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags gnyis kyi mthar arghaṃ sogs nas shabda'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ sngags bzla ba ni/ de nas bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar yi dam sngags kyi phyi nas chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi sngags rnams kyis rim bzhin bskor ba/ lha so so'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon dang bcas pa bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ chos skyong rnams cung zad skrag pa'i rnam pas bka' las 'da' mi nus par bsams la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig tsam bzlas/ slar yang 'od 'phros chos skyong so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas/ rab tu mnyes shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ thog mar mgon po la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ oṃ ro ru sogs de'i phyed dang mnyam pa/ zangs gri can la/ oṃ ma hā kā la rū pa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgon po'i phyed dang*/ las mgon mo gnyis la dmigs te/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bhyoḥdzaḥdzaḥ lha mo'i phyed dang*/ pho gsum la dmigs te/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥshaṃ shaṃ/ li shi ded a shwa ded/ mo rmugs/ spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥnag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ mo'i phyed bzla'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/

rlung ro lan gsum bus/ lte ba'i yum chen las 'od zer tsha zhing drag pa drod kyi rang bzhin 'phros/ snying gar song*/ g.yas ro ma'i pho rgyud la phog pas rang dbang med par bskul te/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung phyir 'gro ba dang lhan cig tu dregs pa pho rgyud nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad pho rgyud du byas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dregs pa pho rgyud rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa tshur 'dus rlung nang du 'jug pa dang mnyam du sna bug g.yas nas zhugs/ rlung gnas pa dang mnyam du pho rgyud rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum bsdoms pa la 'phreng ba re bskyur ba'i grangs nyer gcig tsam ji ltar rigs pa bzung ba ni dbang du bsdu ba'o// yang 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu sna bug g.yas nas zhugs/ rlung gnas pa dang mnyam du nang gi pho rgyud rnams la thim pas de dag byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sngar bzhin dbang du bsdu ba dang grangs mnyam du bya/ de bzhin du g.yon gyi mo rgyud dang*/ dbu ma'i gnyis med rgyud la'ang dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa sngar bzhin grangs mnyam du bya ba'o// gsum pa las sbyor ni/ rgyun gyi dmigs par lte ba'i yum chen dang bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub la bzod par dka' ba 'phros/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas 'dar zhing skrag pa dang*/ dgra bgegs la khro 'khrug rngam pa'i nyams kyis rang 'dra'i sprul pa drag gtum mtshon cha thogs pa stong gsum gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ bdag gi chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa la sogs pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

sha khrag rus pa klad pa la sogs pa zhal du dmar chil chil gsol pas rjes med du btang*/ de dag gi rnam par shes pa dang rang sems ro gcig tu bsres la 'dzin med du bzhag go /slar yang srung ma rnams tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu yang yang bya zhing*/ shā sa na spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ lha mo dang las mgon rnams kyi rbad bsad man ngag ltar bzla'o// mi shes na bsnyen sngags rnams kyi mjug tu/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces btags pa cung zad tsam bzlas par bya'o// de nas thun las ldang bar 'dod pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ pu tra ming sring gsum nam mkha' gang bar 'phros dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad de gsum du gyur/ tshur 'dus nang gi ming sring gsum la thim pa'i rkyen gyis de gsum gnod sbyin yab yum la thim/ spro bsdu de bzhin du byas la/ gnod sbyin yab yum mgon po lcam dral la thim/ lcam dral zangs gri can/ de gsum bla ma he ru ka la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas thig le sngo ba 'tsher ba 'dril ba sran chung tsam gcig tu bsam/ de la sems zhugs pa bzhin gtad la rlung kha sbyar bzung*/ zug skye ba na dal bus btang*/ thig le hūm̐ yig sngon po gcig tu gyur/ de las chos skyong gi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig chad/ 'od zer dmar po ba thag lta bu'i sna las nar gyis byung*/ lte ba'i yum chen gyi spyi bo nas thogs med du zhugs/ gsang gnas padma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i ze'u 'bru'i khrod nas sor phyed tsam phyir thon nas gnas pa la phyi rol gyi dregs pa can thams cad thim par bsams la/ sems 'dzin med du cig nas 'jog pa ni/ gsang rten lus la sba ba zhes bya ste/ 'di lta bu nyin mtshan dus drug tu dran pa tsam byas na chos skyong 'phral med du mi 'khor re zhes rje sa skya pa chen pos dbu bsnyung bzhes zhes grag go

/gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ bsdu rim khro bo bcu dang 'bral na gong ltar ram/ gtso rkyang ltar na snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu ba'am gtso bo'i bar bsdus kyang rung ste gang mos bya'o// gtor ma 'bul ba ni dgongs thun la gtor ma byin rlabs kye rdo rje ltar byas la/ yi dam dang chos skyong dgur mgon zhal bzhi las mgon dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar la gtor chog ltar rgyas par 'bul/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ mgon po'i rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nag po chen po 'grub gyur nas zhes sogs dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs// gdul ka 'dul byed ces sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ rdzu 'phrul mthu chen bi shwa na ra'i bus// bdud dgra'i tshang tshing yongs zos 'jigs rung sku'i// ye shes 'od gzi ma bzod dregs pa'i sdes// ci bgyir bka' nyan phyir 'khod las kun sgrub// lha yi lhar gyur gsang gsum bsgom bzlas kyis// gnas skabs bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam rgyal nas// mthar thug grub mchog ster ba gdams pa'i bcud// skal bzang sku bzhi'i gsos su snying gar sbas// gsang don bkrol ba'i bsod nams skye bo cog /dbang thob dam tshig mi 'dor srog ltar bsrung*// rim gnyis rnal 'byor spyod mchog pha rol phyin// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub phyir bsngo// zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo dang nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor khyad par ba'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i go mtshon zhes bya ba 'di ni/

ji ltar nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge shin tu gsal bar gyis shig ces/ 'bri klung nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs dbon stod dgon gyi dbu mdzad ye shes lhun grub pa dang dge slong tshul khrims chos dar zung gis gsung nan gyis bskul ba'i g.yar khral du/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab gzhir byas/ der ma gsal ba rnams khrid yig dang yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams bzang po la sogs pa chos bzhin spyod kyin chos bzhin 'doms pa rnams kyi gsung don gyis kyang cung zad brgyan te blo gros rno rtul kun gyis nyams su blang bde bar snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ba bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bsdebs pa 'gro ba thams cad bdud las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// gnyis min nag po cher btud de// mgon po khro bo bcur bcas pa'i// sgrub thabs rgyun du khyer bde 'dri// de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar ram/ mi nus na/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos dang dge 'dun thams cad la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// ci nus dang*/ gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// nag po chen po bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang tshogs zhing lhan cig pa ni/ gnas khang dur khrod rol pa'i nang*// nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i khri// padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng*// brgyud pa kun 'dus drin chen rje// bla ma rdo rje nag po che// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs sku// bdag la mkhyen brtse nus pa yis// rjes su skyong bzhin bzhugs par gyur// phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras// bstan srung nor lha spyan drangs bstim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// sdig ltung mthol bshags dge la dga'// don dam byang chub sems mchog gzung*// sangs rgyas thob phyir lam la 'jug

/dge ba gzhan don byang chub bsngo// lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// bstan srung 'khor bcas rang dbang 'dus// las bzhi phrin las lhun grub par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gsol btab la dgongs dgyes bzhin zhu// rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres// de'i bar du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bder gnas btang snyoms la gnas gyur// oṃ chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings// suṃ skyes rdo rje'i brag rdzong steng*// e las chos 'byung khrag mtsho'i klong*// hūm̐ byung rdo rje sa gzhi dang*// rwa gur srung 'khor yangs pa 'bar// badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ de nang hūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sbubs stong brtan// tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐/ dbus dang phyogs bcur pad nyi ror// hūm̐ res mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las// rdo rje gur mgon lha bcu gcig /sgyu ma ltar snang gtso bo'i phyag /gri gug thod pa gaṇḍi bsnams// ye shes me klong zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga lder 'phro// gzhan rnams brkyang bskum gri gug 'phyar// kun kyang mthing nag khro 'khrugs rngam// spyan gsum mche gtsigs mgo phreng dang*// rus rgyan sbrul stag dar gyis bklubs// me dpung klong bzhugs phyi rol du// dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ 'od kyis// rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra byon// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrigs lnga yang*// tshur byon bdag la dbang bskur gsol// des kyang oṃ badzrī bha wa// a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dbang bskur// dbang thob mi bskyod spyi bor brgyan// bskyed rim mo// rang gi snying gar rdo rje'i lter// hūm̐ yig bsrung bya sngags kyis bskor// lha rnams sngags kyi 'brug stong ldir// 'khor lo 'bar bas gdon bgegs bsregs// oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa ci nus dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ shā sa na'ang ci nus bzlas mthar/ nag po chen po'i gsang gsum gyis// bdag dang sems can byin gyis brlabs// 'khor 'das dregs pa dbang 'dus nas// bstan 'gror phan pa sgrub par shog /gnyis pa bzlog pa ni/ rtsibs bar nṛ tri sri rnams las// dgra bo gnod byed dmigs nas bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ drag pos// khro bo phyir gzigs 'khor lo yang*// g.yon 'khor dgra bgegs dum bur gtubs// shā sa na spel tshig btags pa mang du bzla'o// spel tshig ni i daṃ duṣṭāṃ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra mā ra sogs man chad dkyus ltar brjod pas chog go /bha ya nā sa tshar gsum brjod mthar/ bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i dgra// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang sems dgra// kun gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams// byad ma rang gshed bzlog cing bsgyur// bsad bsgral rnam shes chos dbyings sbyor// 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog go /hūm̐ hūm̐/ lha rnams nang gzigs 'khor lo 'khor// tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// snod bcud zhu ba srung 'khor thim// srung 'khor khro bo gdan bcas kyang*// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang nyid rdo rje gur mgon gsal// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nag po chen po 'grub gyur sogs// bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i zhes sogs brjod do// smras pa/ kun mthong chung ngur snang srid dngos// ma 'gags 'char ba'i rten 'brel 'dis// rjod byed nyung ngur brjod bya'i lam// kun nas rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar mtshon// 'dir 'bad bsod nams mig gsum mes// bgegs dgra'i yid srub lus bcom nas// mi mthun las rgyal rgyal mtshan che// bstan pa'i mkha' dkyil bsgreng phyir bsngo// zhes rdo rje gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/

sde dge ban tshang pa mkhas btsun dkon mchog bzang pos bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa bi dza yastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
